title: Agent preferences: user preference to tool boundary
lede: The user sets what their AI agent may do; a mock Protect evaluation names an AI agent at session start; the mock tool boundary enforces the preference on every agent tool call: permit, human approval (HITL) or deny. Mock only.

steps.title: Session starts: signals to Protect
steps.what: The browser collects Signals once; mock Protect's bot detection names (or does not name) an AI agent.

steps.title: Detection flags the session
steps.what: A detected rule (e.g. "AI agent - Muse detected") flags the session for every later agent call.

steps.title: Agent calls a tool
steps.what: The agent calls the tool boundary with its delegated token.

steps.title: Gate reads the preference
steps.what: The gate reads the user's agentPreferences: allowed tiers, spend cap, unknown-agent policy.

steps.title: Gate decides
steps.what: Permit, HITL or deny: tier not allowed, amount over cap, or detection against the unknown-agent policy.

steps.title: HITL: a human decides
steps.what: On hitl the call becomes a 428 challenge with a task id; the human approves or denies; approval lets the retry proceed.

steps.title: Permitted call executes
steps.what: Only a permitted call reaches the tool.
